name: Beef Dip Sandwich with Sautéed Veggies & Oven-Baked Fries

cookwares.name: stainless steel or cast iron skillet

instructions.primary_message: Wash, peel, and slice potatoes into ¼-inch thick strips. Place on a large baking sheet and toss with oil and salt.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 medium yellow potatoes
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Spread potatoes out in a single layer and place in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated). Roast until golden brown, tossing once halfway through, 15-20 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel and thinly slice onions. Peel and mince garlic. Transfer both to a large bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium yellow onions
3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Thinly slice steak against the grain. Add steak and salt to the bowl with the onion and toss to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg striploin (New York strip) steak
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: When the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add steak mixture and cook, stirring often, until steak is browned and cooked to desired doneness, 5-7 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry bell peppers and mushrooms. On a clean cutting board, thinly slice the mushrooms and peppers.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ red bell peppers
⅓ kg cremini mushrooms

instructions.primary_message: When the steak is done, transfer to a large bowl and cover with aluminum foil. Return skillet to medium heat; add oil, peppers, and mushrooms. Cook, stirring often, until veggies are browned, 6-8 minutes. Add veggies to the bowl with the steak.
In a small bowl, make a slurry by whisking broth with cornstarch until smooth.
instructions.secondary_message:
177 ml chicken or vegetable broth
1 tbsp cornstarch

instructions.primary_message: Return skillet to medium-high heat; add the cornstarch slurry, additional broth, Worcestershire sauce, pepper, and any juices from the bowl with the steak. Cook, whisking constantly, until slightly thickened, 2-3 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
532 ml chicken or vegetable broth
1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Split buns in half and place on a baking sheet pan, cut-side facing up. Layer cheese over bottom buns. Place in the oven and toast until bread is golden brown, and cheese is melted, 2-3 minutes.
Divide steak and veggies between bottom buns, drizzle with warm sauce and top with the other half of the bun. Serve with fries and remaining sauce on the side for dipping. Enjoy!
